summary: Created a 6-phase implementation plan for the /sapience command, integrating the research report's nine recommendations. The plan adds no new script: commands/sapience.md and skills/skill-sapience/SKILL.md are pure consumers of the four scripts tasks 647/648 already built, and no Agent-tool dispatch is needed anywhere, which dissolves the AskUserQuestion tool-withholding constraint rather than working around it. Two mechanical gate collisions the research report did not measure were measured live and now shape Phase 5: EXTENSION.md sits at exactly 60 lines, precisely at Rule U's ceiling, and README.md (omitted from the dispatch FILE SCOPE) must literally contain /sapience or check_readme_vs_manifest hard-fails. The plan validates with 0 warnings.
